items.title: Merck (MRK) Ties New AI Oncology Discovery Deal To Future Pipeline Growth
items.summary: Merck (NYSE:MRK) agreed a new oncology drug discovery collaboration with Isomorphic Labs that centers on advanced AI driven molecule design. The partnership combines Merck's internal oncology data with Isomorphic Labs' computational models to identify and optimize new cancer drug candidates. Both groups plan to use the AI platform across multiple early stage discovery programs, targeting areas where traditional screening has been slow.
